# Isaiah Chapter 55 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 13 verses]*

*Come to the waters; seek the LORD; word shall not return empty; mountains and hills sing; peace*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 55 (Invitation to the Thirsty) addresses come to the waters; seek the lord; word shall not return empty; mountains and hills sing; peace. The key verse — "My thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, declares the LORD" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to Second Isaiah (chs. 40-55), focused on comfort, restoration, and the servant figure.
